summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on embedded systems testing and debugging experience across bare-metal C firmware and embedded Linux (NVIDIA Jetson) platforms. Designed and validated low-level I2C/SPI/UART device drivers, systematically debugged multi-sensor hardware integration to reach 100% test reliability, and led cross-functional engineering teams through complex technical validation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and debugging.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through systematic debugging; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation) on embedded Linux, with static IP networking for reliable multi-device communication.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection via dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over I2C mux.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson (embedded Linux) to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override; debugged timing and jitter issues across the sensor-to-actuator pipeline.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
